# Cncf Cdk For Kubernetes Cdk8s Reviewer

Review CDK for Kubernetes (CDK8s) using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Automation &amp; Configuration category. CDK8s lets you define Kubernetes apps and components using familiar programming languages and object-oriented APIs.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
